meta.class_full_name_zh: 遥控多旋翼无人机竞速（RC Multi-Rotor Drone Racing）
meta.class_full_name_en: FAI Sporting Code Section 4 - Volume F9 Drone Sport, Class F9U (Provisional)
meta.purpose: Machine-readable F9U rule spec for code (Minecraft Fabric FPV racing module). All numeric facts come from the 6 cited source PDFs; where a value is not found it is null with a note in evidence_gaps.

rule_variants.FAI_2023: FAI Volume F9 Drone Sport 2023 Edition (eff. 2023-02-01) - base class rules + Annex C.1-C.4
rule_variants.FAI_2025_proposal: CIAM 2025 Plenary F9 proposals (amendments under vote; not yet the published volume)
rule_variants.TWG_2025: 2025 World Games Drone Racing Sporting Rules v1 (May 2024)
rule_variants.CN_2026_nationals: 2026 全国航空航天模型锦标赛竞赛规则 (F9U = section 5.25)
rule_variants.CN_2026_league_regs: 2026 中国无人机竞速联赛竞赛规程 (season calendar/points only; delegates detail to a separate league rulebook)
rule_variants.CN_2025_open: 2025 全国航空模型公开赛(河北塞北站)竞赛规则 (F9U = section 3.5)

lap_count.note: Standard heat = 3 consecutive laps. FAI_2023 left lap count to organiser; FAI_2025_proposal + TWG_2025 + CN_2026_nationals fix it at 3 laps for qualification/elimination/final.

sources.FAI_2025_proposal: proposals k) C.6.3, C.6.4, n) C.6.5, o) C.6.6: '3 consecutive laps to complete'
sources.CN_2025_open: 3.5.4: '完成规定圈数和任务' (lap count set by course; not fixed at 3)

flight_time_limit_per_heat_seconds.note: FAI_2025_proposal / TWG_2025 = 3 minutes (180 s) allowed once 3 laps done or limit reached, must land. CN_2026_nationals qualification allows up to 4 minutes (240 s). CN_2025_open does not state a fixed per-heat time.
flight_time_limit_per_heat_seconds.land_when: completed required laps OR time limit reached -> must land

sources.FAI_2025_proposal: k) C.6.3 / C.6.4 / n) C.6.5 / o) C.6.6: '3 minutes flight time allowed'
sources.CN_2026_nationals: 5.25.6(2): 排位赛飞行时间最长不得超过4分钟

A_competition_structure.landing_after_completion: After 3 laps done or time over, model must land immediately; CN_2026_nationals & CN_2025_open require return to designated landing area.

closed_loop.note: FAI_2023 allowed closed loop (multi-lap) OR open loop (single pass). FAI_2025_proposal d) removes open loop: circuit SHALL be a closed loop with 3 laps. TWG_2025 = closed circuit.

sources.FAI_2023: C.2: closed loop or open loop both allowed
sources.FAI_2025_proposal: d) C.2 reason: 'Removal of the open loop option (Only closed loop with 3 laps)'

loop_type.open_loop: permitted only in FAI_2023 base text; removed by 2025 proposal.

sectors.default: track MAY be divided into sectors (optional).

sources.FAI_2023: C.2: 'the track can be divided into sectors to facilitate timekeeping'
sources.FAI_2025_proposal: d) C.2: 'Optionally, the track may be divided into sectors'

start_to_finish_min_distance_m.measured_along: centreline of the optimum 3D flight path, start line to finish line, INCLUDING all laps
start_to_finish_min_distance_m.note: Confirmed 250 m minimum. Domestic docs differ: CN_2026_nationals single lap <450 m; CN_2025_open single lap 80-100 m (short grassroots course).

sources.FAI_2023: C.2: 'minimum length ... start line to end line, including all laps, is 250 m ... measured along the centerline of the optimum 3D flight path'

min_air_gate_count.note: FAI documents do NOT state a minimum air-gate count. The hypothesis '>=4' is NOT confirmed. Only CN_2025_open specifies a count: at least 3 to 5 arch gates.

pilots_per_heat.note: FAI: max 4 per heat recommended (esp. elimination/final); qualifying may be 6. TWG_2025: exactly 4 per group. CN_2026_nationals: 4 per group, max 6 (>=3 for valid result).

sources.FAI_2023: C.6 intro / C.6.3: max 4, qualifying up to 6
sources.CN_2026_nationals: 5.25.6(1): 每小组4人，最多6人（3人及以上成绩有效）

B_gates_obstacles.note: FAI Annex C.1 defines only MINIMUM clear apertures (not a fixed gate catalog). The only concrete named gate opening size across all 6 sources is the domestic arch gate. Square/flag/circle/tunnel catalogs with exact m dimensions were NOT found in these 6 documents.

gate_to_cross_min_internal_clear_diamete.unit: meters (minimum diameter of free space centred on optimum flight path)
gate_to_cross_min_internal_clear_diamete.note: Applies to air gates / gate combinations / tunnels. Internal space must be free of rigging (wire/rope).
gate_to_cross_min_internal_clear_diamete.source: FAI_2023 Annex C.1 section 4.1: 'obstacle inside shall be free space within a minimum diameter of 1.5 m centered in the optimal flight path'

obstacle_to_avoid_min_free_space_diamete.unit: meters (minimum free space diameter centred on optimum 3D flight path)
obstacle_to_avoid_min_free_space_diamete.note: Applies to walls/flags/pylons/flyers to be avoided; slalom structures.
obstacle_to_avoid_min_free_space_diamete.source: FAI_2023 Annex C.1 section 4.2: 'free space shall be of a minimum 2.5 m diameter centered in the optimal 3D flight path'

gate_visibility_distance_m.unit: meters: obstacles must contrast with background and be perfectly visible with a standard FPV video device at 30 m

gate_catalog.type_zh: 拱门 / 障碍门 (arch / air gate to cross)
gate_catalog.extra: Consecutively placed arch gates count as ONE gate. Arch gate must be >=20 m from pilot station; >=5 m straight approach before gate; gate placement angle <=10 deg.
gate_catalog.source: CN_2025_open 3.5.5.1: 拱门宽度1.6-2.0米，高度1.3-1.5米；至少3至5个；距操纵区不少于20米；进入前至少5米直线；放置角度不大于10度

gate_catalog.type_zh: 任务单元 / 其它障碍 (task unit / other obstacle)
gate_catalog.extra: May be on ground or up to 3 m above ground.
gate_catalog.source: CN_2025_open 3.5.5.2: 每个任务单元最小尺寸0.5米×0.5米，可放地面或不高于地面3米位置

gate_catalog.type_zh: 方块门/旗门/圆环/隧道 (square gate / flag gate / ring / tunnel)
gate_catalog.note: NOT FOUND with exact dimensions in any of the 6 sources. FAI only gives the 1.5 m minimum clear aperture for anything-to-cross; the domestic docs only give the arch gate. Treat gate shapes as open to organiser; code should parameterize opening box (min 1.5 m clear) rather than assume a fixed catalog.

gate_numbering_color_standards.color_spec: Models carry LED colors (Blue-Green-Red-Yellow-Cyan-Magenta) for pilot identification, NOT gate colors. Gate color = must contrast with background / clearly visible.

sources.CN_2026_nationals: 5.25.1(9): LED colors 蓝-绿-红-黄-青-品红

obstacle_disappearance_wait_seconds.note: The hypothesized '10 s wait after an obstacle disappears' is NOT a racing-gate rule. FAI C.7.1: when an obstacle is damaged/destroyed, pilots are informed; officials decide continue / allow bypass / stop race. The 10 s figure found in domestic docs applies only to FREE-FLIGHT timed events (model hidden behind obstacle -> wait 10 s) and to the 3rd-view microsdr course overturn recovery (>10 s = stop), NOT to F9U gate racing.

sources.FAI_2023: C.7.1: no fixed wait; decision to continue/bypass/stop
sources.CN_2025_open: 3.7.7.2 (第三视角): 翻转超过10秒未复飞则终止

track_min_width_height_clearance.note: No explicit minimum track width/height envelope. Only the per-obstacle clear apertures (1.5 m gate / 2.5 m avoid free space) and FPV 30 m visibility.
track_min_width_height_clearance.indoor_reference_only: F9A drone soccer indoor ceiling >=5 m (not F9U)

start_line_placement.FAI_2023: side-by-side single line perpendicular to start trajectory, spacing 0.5-1.0 m; OR inverted-V (0.5 m side / 0.5 m f-b min, 1.0 m side / 1.5 m back max)
start_line_placement.FAI_2025_proposal: side-by-side single line only; recommended 60-120 deg turn before first gate, flagged >=10 m from start line and gate

finish_line.definition: 2D area to be crossed; pilot finishes when model touches and completely crosses it
finish_line.source: FAI_2023 Annex C.1 section 5 Finish line

manual_timing_allowed.FAI_2023: allowed if announced 1 month ahead (not recommended)

resolution_seconds.note: CN_2026_nationals: 计时精确到0.01秒. FAI/TWG do not state a numeric resolution beyond 'accurate/electronic'.
resolution_seconds.source: CN_2026_nationals 5.25.5(3): 电子计时系统，计时精确到0.01秒

C_timing_triggers.qualification_trigger: per-model clock starts when the model passes the gate fitted with timing sensor(s); after take-off from start area the model must fly DIRECTLY to that timing gate.
C_timing_triggers.elimination_final_trigger: clock starts at the start signal (when sounded).

sources.FAI_2023: C.6.1: qualifying triggered at timing gate; else at start
sources.CN_2026_nationals: 5.25.5(4): 排位赛以通过计时门触发；淘汰/决赛以起飞信号触发

C_timing_triggers.unfinished_laps_count: Laps not completed are NOT recorded and do not contribute to result/placing/tie-break (FAI_2025_proposal h); unfinished single laps not recorded (CN_2026 5.25.5(5)).

qualification_method.FAI_2023_method_a: fastest time to complete organiser-defined required laps (not recommended when <=3 rounds)
qualification_method.FAI_2023_method_b: average of the 3 best single VALID lap times across ALL qualifying rounds (laps may come from same or different rounds); default 3 but organiser may use 2 or 4
qualification_method.TWG_2025: 4 qualifying rounds; rank by average of the 3 fastest valid single-lap times across all rounds; pilots with only 2 times ranked after those with 3, those with 1 after those with 2
qualification_method.CN_2026_nationals: >=3 rounds; take the BEST completed (3-lap) result across rounds as valid result; tie -> fastest single lap, then next better round, etc. 2-lap finishers ranked after 3-lap, 1-lap after 2-lap
qualification_method.CN_2025_open: 2 rounds, take best round; tie -> other round
qualification_method.note: User hypothesis 'average of 3 fastest single laps' = TRUE for FAI method b and TWG_2025, but CN_2026_nationals instead uses best whole-round (3-lap) time. Code should make the aggregation function configurable.

D_ranking_algorithm.tie_break_qualification: FAI b: 4th-best single lap, then 5th, etc.; else tie-break flight. CN_2026: fastest single lap then another better round.

elimination.format: top 2 of each heat advance directly; 3rd/4th go to double-elimination bracket if applied

double_elimination.applied_CN_2026: single elimination until top-16, THEN double elimination until top-4
double_elimination.elimination_rule: 3rd & 4th place in a double-elimination heat are definitively eliminated; upper-bracket 3rd/4th drop to lower bracket

final.FAI_2023: default single final; optional successive final races until one finalist wins 2; points 1/2/3/4 per race for places 2-4
final.TWG_2025: top 2 from last elimination race + top 2 from last double-elim race -> final; successive final races until one wins 2; points 1/2/3/4
final.CN_2026_nationals: top 4 from double elimination -> final; point system 4/3/2/1 per final round (DNF=0); max 5 final rounds; ends when 1st place points reach an absolute (unbeatable) total

league_season_points_CN_2026.beyond_64: by qualification result; >=1 valid finished round = 1
league_season_points_CN_2026.team: sum of best 4 athletes per team

E_takeoff_landing.takeoff_area: models placed on start line/pods; pilots have 2 min max to be ready; 'Pilots, arm your quads' then 2-4 s (random in 2025 proposal; ~3 s in 2023/TWG) start tone, no countdown
E_takeoff_landing.not_ready_penalty: model not on start pod after 2-min prep, OR fails to take off within 5 s of start signal -> that race/round DQ (CN_2026 5.25.8(4) / 5.25.14 A; CN_2025_open 3.5.6.1)

must_return_to_landing_zone.note: CN_2025_open: '未返回降落区，成绩无效'. CN_2026_nationals 5.25.8(3): '立即返回降落区'; 5.25.14 C: not landing in designated area / celebratory flying after finish = race DQ. FAI/TWG: there is a pick-up area after finish but no hard 'must return or score invalid' wording.

sources.CN_2025_open: 3.5.4: 完成规定圈数和任务并返回降落区。未返回降落区，成绩无效

touch_ground_or_crash_ends_heat.cn_2025_open: landing <=5 s OR recoverable crash: may continue BUT +30 s; landing >5 s OR unflyable crash: heat stopped, score 0
touch_ground_or_crash_ends_heat.fai: if model cannot continue after crash, it stays on ground motors-off until race end; pilot removes goggles; helper+ pilot stay quiet. No automatic +30 s in FAI.

E_takeoff_landing.crash_procedure: pilot removes goggles to signal retirement; model stays on ground with power cut/locked; pilot+helper silent until race ends; (2025 proposal) activate pit mode to cut VTX power.

abandon_task_or_incomplete_penalty_secon.applies: CN_2025_open only: abandoning OR not completing a task unit -> total time +30 s. Also a <=5 s landing / recoverable crash -> +30 s continue.
abandon_task_or_incomplete_penalty_secon.source: CN_2025_open 3.5.4: 某项任务放弃或未完成则总时间加30秒；着陆不超过5秒或摔机可继续者加时30秒
abandon_task_or_incomplete_penalty_secon.fai_equivalent: FAI has NO +30 s penalty; missing a gate = that lap not validated, may re-fly the gate; correction collision = race DQ.

missed_gate_wrong_order.FAI: missed obstacle / missed pylon-flag / shortcut -> that lap NOT validated; pilot may immediately and safely correct; if corrected the lap counts; collision during correction = race DQ
missed_gate_wrong_order.CN_2026_nationals: wrong line or missed mark may self-correct else round invalid; collision while correcting = round DQ; only the collided-upon pilot in qualifying may reflight
missed_gate_wrong_order.CN_2025_open: must return and re-do missed task, else round invalid

false_start.FAI_TWG: model leaves start position before signal and progresses through first gate -> race DQ (race not stopped)
false_start.CN_2026_nationals: false start: race continues, offender penalized; start before signal listed as round DQ (5.25.14 B)

race_DQ_conditions: early start / false start through first gate
collision while correcting a missed gate
celebratory / aerobatic maneuver, esp. after finishing
not landing in designated area / celebratory flying after finish (CN)
model not on pod at 2-min prep end or not airborne 5 s after start signal (CN)
event_DQ_conditions: VTX over max power or unauthorized activation
same model used by different competitors
not stopping after a false-start DQ

reflight_policy.individual_reflight: qualification stage ONLY (FAI/TWG/CN_2026); original flight cancelled
reflight_policy.heat_restart: before-first-gate mid-air collision (one restart per race), critical safety incident, external incident, deliberate unfair advantage (2025 proposal C.8.2)
reflight_policy.no_reflight_for: video issue, collision, in elimination/final/additional rounds

wording.FAI_2023: Note in C.1: 'Software recovery modes such as anti Turtle or anti crash and automatic system which can be activated by the pilot in order to level back the model after a crash are permitted.'
wording.FAI_2025_proposal: 'Flip over after crash' (also known as Turtle mode) / Crash recovery permitted
wording.TWG_2025: 'Flip over after crash' (Turtle mode) / Crash recovery permitted
wording.CN_2025_open: 3.5.4: 飞行期间若坠落，允许使用'反乌龟'模式，在不接触模型的情况下，反转模型（without touching the model）
wording.CN_2025_open_F9A: 3.6.3: 允许使用'反乌龟'模式，在不接触模型的情况下翻转模型

G_anti_turtle.constraint: must be pilot-activated software after crash to right the model; forbidden: pre-programmed maneuvers, automatic positioning/path correction (GPS/position hold). Manual touching the model to flip it is NOT the permitted case in CN_2025_open (it must be done WITHOUT touching the model).

H_hardware.note: MC (multi-rotor) model class. Recorded separately per user request.

sources.CN_2026_nationals: F9U follows FAI; 2.3 lists F9U=3 frames

motor_axis_circle_diameter_mm.note: axes of all motors must fit within a 330 mm diameter circle (= wheelbase/轴距 <=330 mm).

cell_full_charge_voltage_max_v.note: max voltage per cell when fully charged. Implies 4S=17 V, 6S=25.5 V. Measured before flight (FAI) / before EACH race (TWG).

sources.TWG_2025: 2.2: 4.25 V when fully charged, measured before each race

max_s_count.note: FAI/TWG allow up to 6S; the grassroots CN_2025_open restricts to 3S.

H_hardware.rc: 2.4 GHz spread spectrum; 868/915 MHz (900 MHz) modules max 100 mW; 433 MHz not authorized in China

video.band: 5.8 GHz only (2025 proposal/TWG); Raceband R 5658-5917 MHz
video.pit_mode_required: 2025 proposal: VTX pit mode (cuts video power) mandatory
video.personal_rx: must be mounted directly on goggles, extend <=160 mm above goggle connector; no external mast/stand antennas

H_hardware.identification_mark: 3-letter national mark + FAI licence/ID number, >=6 mm high (FAI) / readable at arm's length (TWG); domestic: national letters + membership number >=25 mm

max_frames_per_competitor.note: one model may be used by only one competitor per event

H_hardware.autonomy: no pre-programmed maneuvers, no automatic positioning/path correction; STABILISE/self-level (自稳) allowed; FPV manual throughout; helper mandatory (VLOS spotter).

evidence_gaps: Exact dimensions (opening width x height in m) for a STANDARD catalog of named gates (square gate 方块门 / flag gate 旗门 / ring 圆环 / tunnel 隧道) are NOT given in any of the 6 sources. FAI Annex C.1 only specifies a minimum 1.5 m clear diameter for to-cross gates and 2.5 m free space for to-avoid obstacles. Only the domestic arch gate (宽1.6-2.0 m x 高1.3-1.5 m) has a concrete opening size.
Minimum air-gate count >=4 NOT confirmed. FAI/TWG set no minimum; CN_2025_open says 3-5 arch gates.
'Obstacle disappears -> wait 10 s' is NOT an F9U racing rule in these sources; the 10 s figure belongs to free-flight timed events and the 3rd-view microdrone course.
Per-race flight time limit: FAI/TWG = 180 s (3 min); CN_2026_nationals qualification = up to 240 s (4 min); CN_2025_open has no fixed limit. No single universal value.
Gate numbering / color-coding spec for the gates themselves is not defined (only model LED colors are).
Minimum track width / height clearance envelope not defined (only per-obstacle apertures and 30 m FPV visibility).

2026 中国无人机竞速联赛 references a separate 《2026年中国无人机竞速联赛竞赛规则》 detailed rulebook; the provided 规程 PDF contains only season structure, team roster and points, not gate/lap detail. That detailed league rulebook was not among the supplied URLs.

FAI 2025 plenary items are PROPOSALS (several passed by S/C vote) but are amendments to be incorporated; the currently PUBLISHED Volume F9 is the 2023 edition. Where 2023 text and 2025 proposal conflict, both are recorded.
FAI_2023 does not state a numeric timing resolution; only CN_2026_nationals specifies 0.01 s.
